summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests MB-CART19.1, a cell therapy made from modified T cells collected from the participant's blood, in adults with relapsed or refractory primary or secondary central nervous system lymphoma. It is given as a single infusion during an inpatient stay, 2 to 7 days after conditioning chemotherapy, following blood collection and cell manufacturing. The study tests different doses to find the highest dose that causes few or mild side effects; a formal main outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa MB-CART19.1, una terapia celular hecha con linfocitos T modificados obtenidos de la sangre del participante, en adultos con linfoma del sistema nervioso central primario o secundario recidivante o refractario. Se administra como una sola infusión durante una hospitalización, de 2 a 7 días después de la quimioterapia de acondicionamiento, tras la recolección de sangre y la fabricación de las células. El estudio prueba distintas dosis para encontrar la dosis más alta que cause pocos efectos secundarios o leves; no se indica una medida de resultado principal formal.
who_for: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) in the central nervous system, primary or secondary
Relapsed or refractory disease after at least one prior CNS-directed methotrexate-based therapy
Relapsed: brain or spine lesions progressing on imaging within 21 days of consent
Refractory: residual disease after the last line of therapy
not_for: Active lymphoma outside the central nervous system
Prior CD19-targeted CAR T cell therapy for systemic lymphoma
Most recent CSF or brain tissue shows no CD19 expression
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or LVEF below 40%, or HIV, or active hepatitis B or C
